Detail-oriented accounting professional with hands-on experience in transactional accounting, GST compliance, and vendor management. Proven ability to streamline payables processes, maintain accurate ledgers using Tally, and prepare financial reconciliations and reports in Excel. Comfortable working in fast-paced environments with short notice period.

Finance Executive | On-site

Finance Executive | On-site
